title: Design and Implementation of Aircraft Environment Controller Based on DSP
abstract: Aiming at the control requirements of the aircraft internal environment during flight and meeting the tracking control of the aircraft environmental control system for the set target; this paper propose an embedded control system based on TMS320F28335. The control system adopts a fuzzy control strategy to control typical aircraft environmental parameters——temperature and pressure. This paper introduces the design and working theory of the embedded control system from both software and hardware. Based on the system design; this paper has completed the development of the prototype and conducted ground test verification. Through experimental verification and summary analysis of experimental results; this paper proven that the designed control system has good engineering practical value.
keywords: aircraft environmental control system, embedded control system, pressure, temperature

title: A Method for Specific Communication Emitter Identification Based on Multi-Domain Feature Fusion
abstract: To solve the problem of low identification rate caused by specific communication emitter identification using a single feature; a method for individual identification of the communication emitter based on multi-domain feature fusion is proposed. Firstly; multiple transform domain features of the signals transmitted by the communication emitter are extracted; and these features are combined into multi-domain features.Secondly; the multi-channel convolution neural network is constructed; and the multi-channel convolution operation is carried out to extract the multi-domain features at a deep level. Finally; specificcommunication emitter classification is completed using the neural network classifier.Compared with the identification method based on a single feature; this method makes full use of the multi-domain features of the signals sent by the communication emitter and combines the powerful microscopic feature mining capability of the neural network to realize the effective individual identification of the communication emitter. Through the identification of 20 CC2530 devices under the conditions of low signal-to-noise ratio（SNR） and Rayleigh channel; the results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the identification accuracy and timeliness under a low SNR; and that the identification effect can still reach 91.01% under the condition of 0 dB.
keywords: communication emitter identification, feature fusion, low signal-to-noise ratio, multi-channel convolution neural network

title: Design and implementation of energy storage battery management system in microgrid
abstract: Combined with the working characteristics of microgrid energy storage battery;a battery management system based on TMS320F2812 and LTC6811 is designed. The master-slave system architecture is adopted;and the slave module is mainly LTC6811. The voltage;current;temperature and other state acquisition circuits and active equalization circuits are established to manage 12 series of battery packs;and communicate with the master module through SPI serial port;In the Code Warrior development environment;the software of the main control module TMS320F2812 minimization system is developed to realize the program design of battery SOC estimation;active balance control;safety protection and so on;and improve the monitoring and management ability of battery packs. Experiments show that the scheme is feasible and effective;the battery data acquisition accuracy is high;the voltage error is within ±5 mV;the temperature error is within ± 1 ℃;and the active equalization effect is obvious;and the SOC difference of the series battery pack is within 1%.

title: Design of intelligent door lock system based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to improve the security of intelligent door lock and realize the remote monitoring and management of door lock;an intelligent door lock system based ZigBee is designed.The system consists of terminal door lock;wireless gateway;platform and user terminal. The system takes CC2530 chip as the core;terminal door lock as the terminal node and wireless gateway as the coordinator to construct ZigBee’s wireless network and realize the network interconnection with the platform.Users can issue control instructions through the platform to realize remote control of the door lock.At the same time;the terminal door lock can detect the state of the door lock and upload the state information to the platform.The test results show that the dormant power consumption of the terminal door lock is less than 20 μA and the success rate of unlocking is more than 95%.The platform can accurately obtain the state of the door lock.It is practical to control the state of the door lock in real time.
keywords: cc2530, intelligent door lock, internet of things, zigbee

title: Design of Embedded Piston-temperature Test System for Engine
abstract: In view of the fact that there is no effective means to measure engine piston temperature;this paper designed one feasible embedded piston-temperature testing system.By selecting K-type thermocouple as temperature sensor and combining AD590 with output compensation voltage of one 2.5 Vreference voltage source;it further compensated thermocouple cold-end temperature accordingly.In addition;it adjusted AD8495 set-point voltage under present temperature to output rising edge for achieving function of adjustable trigger temperature.After collecting temperature data upon 3 test points on top of piston via embedded Analog-to-digital converter（ADC）under control of PIC single chip;it turns out this system can send all test results to receiving platform of upper computer via CC2530.Before test;the entire system was also calibrated within high-temperature cabinet.After completing a series of comparisons between actually-tested values and calibrated ones;subsequent tests upon engine bench would be conducted.And these actually-tested results show that test accuracy of the system can reach±1 ℃.It can normally operate even in high temperature environment up to 130℃;demonstrating better stability and reliability.
keywords: piston for engine, storage test, temperature test, wireless communication

title: New Method for DSP Reconstruction and Immune Single Particle Flip
abstract: According to the problems of joint test action group（JTAG） being not used during on-orbit satellite controller reconstruction and being difficult to update DSP program due to the limitation of working environment;taking digital signal processing（DSP） TMS320 F28335 as an example; a scheme of online reconstruction DSP controller through serial port is proposed. Because the DSP controller may be knocked over by a single particle while the satellite is in orbit; a method of redundancy of the master control program and periodic or instruction reconstruction of the master program to reduce the possibility of invalid of the controller due to the flip of the single particle is proposed. Experimental results show that the method is simple and suitable; stable and reliable operation; and easy to operate; which can realize the reconstruction program of DSP TMS320 F28335 take over the controller after power on; solve the problem of reconstruction of DSP in orbit; and greatly reduce the possibility of being knocked over by single particle. It can be applied to the commercial aerospace embedded field.
keywords: on-orbit reconstruction, reconstruction booting program, single particle inversion, tms320f28335

title: 数字信号处理器单粒子功能性瞬态故障预估方法研究
abstract: 结合特定应用下数字信号处理器单粒子功能故障的产生机理和表征模式;定义了单粒子功能性瞬态故障的概念;提出了利用数字信号处理器内部存储区数据位翻转截面和数据位缓存时间有效占比预估功能性瞬态故障截面的方法。在西安200 MeV质子应用装置上开展了TMS320C6455型数字信号处理器质子辐照实验;对预估方法的有效性进行了验证。实验得到了被测器件的功能性瞬态故障截面和内部存储区数据位翻转截面;并利用预估方法计算得到被测器件功能性瞬态故障截面预估值;实验结果与预估值相对偏差小于5%。

title: 一种提高MLS角度精度的综合测量方法
abstract: The angle measurement of Microwave Landing System(MLS) is studied;and a comprehensive method for improving the accuracy of angle measurement is proposed.In this method;symmetry of the to-and-fro scanning beams is used to suppress multipath interference;the peak detection algorithm based on intersection of straight lines of position is presented to improve angle measurement accuracy;and digital filtering is used to mitigate the impact of noise.The proposed method has been verified by the digital signal processing system based on TMS320 F2812 DSP.The testing results show that the method has the advantages of high measurement accuracy;robustness to multipath interference and easy engineering implementation.

title: Two Methods of Generating Phase-Shifted PWM Based on TMS320F2812
abstract: Phase-shifted PWM wave is a driving pulse signal commonly used in many switching power supplies. The bidirectional-full-bridge DC-DC converter requires four complementary phase-shifted PWM waves in the dual-phase-shift control mode. Two methods for generating phase-shifted PWM based on TMS320 F2812 DSP are presented in this paper.In order to improve the safety and reliability of the bidirectional-full-bridge DC-DC converter; dead time is set for the phase-shifted PWM wave. The proposed method is tested with good test results; which is of great significance for the construction of closed-loop control system of the bidirectional full-bridge DC-DC converter.

title: 基于深度学习的四旋翼无人机控制系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the control system of the traditional quadrotor UAV is affected by external interference and cannot avoid obstacles in time;the control accuracy is low.A design of quadrotor drone control system based on deep learning is proposed.According to the overall structure of the quadrotor drone control system;an ultrasonic ranging module is added.According to the system hardware block diagram;the TMS320 F28335 main control chip is used to achieve intelligent analysis of key situations.Take the control object of the cascade PID controller as the drone attitude angle to control the motor speed.According to the PWM signals with different duty ratios sent by the DSP;the drone’s flight attitude is changed;and the equilibrium state of the drone is ensured according to the driving principle of the actuator.Use infrared remote control system;apply encoding/decoding to control integrated circuit chip;adopt TS0 P1738 infrared receiver;suitable for infrared remote control data transmission.Construct a deep learning target control model;use the similarity principle of the burst array method and the triangle to calculate the pixel size;and obtain the distance from the obstacle to the current position of the drone;to avoid interference from external obstacles.Adaptive extended Kalman filter technology effectively reduces the measurement error of the UAV automatic control system and accurately tracks the maneuvering target.According to the system debugging results;when the turntable angle is 0°;the system controls a pitch angle of31°;a heading angle of 186°;and a roll angle of 0°;which are consistent with the actual values;which is of great significance for handling sudden group events.

title: Design of portable RPV steel irradiation embrittlement detection system based on MBN
abstract: Reactor pressure vessel(RPV)operating under intense neutron irradiation for a long time will suffer radiation damage;which will affect its service life.Aiming at this problem;based on the principle of magnetic Barkhausen noise(MBN)effect;a three-dimensional simulation model of Barkhausen sensor is established.The validity of sensor structure and its optimal parameters are verified by simulation results.At the same time;a portable detection system for irradiation embrittlement of small size RPV steel is developed;which is based on the development board of TMS320F28335.Then;the repeatability and stability of the system are further verified.

title: Systematic design of real-time measuring and reliable transmission for body motion data
abstract: Real-time measuring of multiple motion data is the key issue for motion detection and health monitoring.This paper designs a motion capture system based on CC2530 SOC of TI;including a reliable wireless transmission protocol.It consists of multiple inertial sensors;a sink node;and PC.The sink node and sensor nodes form a star wireless networks;techniques of time-division multiple-access;loss packet detection and re-transmission are used to obtain the reliable transmission.The experimental results show our proposed system is portable;reliable and high-throughput.It can robustly acquire and transmit data from multi nodes in real-time.The system will contribute to the real-time monitoring of physiological parameters as well as motion recognition in human beings.

title: Design and implementation of infusion monitoring system based on improved capacitance detection method
abstract: Objective To design a high-performance; reliable and practical wireless infusion monitoring system to realize automated infusion monitoring. Methods The system was composed of an infusion monitor; an intelligent gateway and a host computer; which used AD7746 chip to monitor the electric capacity; I2 C serial bus for capacity-related data readback;CC2530 SCM for difference calculation and infusion state determination; and Zig Bee technology to execute wireless data transmission at real time. Results The system carried out multi-node monitoring on volume and velocity at real time; and the acquired data were accurate and reliable. Conclusion The system gains advantages over the traditional ways in practicability and reliability when used for infusion monitoring.

abstract: In order to solve the problem of phase-shifted full-bridge circuit driving and phase angle control;a digitally controlled phaseshifted full-bridge driving circuit was designed. title: Design of Shock Wave Test System Based on Android and WiFi
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings that the preparatory work was tedious and the mobility was poor in the current shock wave testing methods such as lead electrical measurement method and storage test method; in this paper; a shock wave testing system scheme was proposed based on Android and WiFi. The system uses Android smart phone as the display; processing tool and recorder control terminal of shock wave data waveforms; and the CC3200 chip(TI) is embedded into the memory recorder as WiFi hot spot. The smart phone connects the hot spot; then remotely controls the recorder and reads the data in the recorder through the UDP protocol of Socket mechanism; finally the phone is used to calculate; process and analyze the shock wave data. Multiple tests show that the Android smart phone can accurately control the recorder and read data at high speed in the range of up to 110 m; and the system runs steadily. The system greatly reduces the preparatory work of the test; and it is convenient; fast and strongly practical.

title: 基于DSP和FPGA的导航系统硬件平台设计
abstract: The navigation computer is designed for initial alignment and navigation computing in strap-down inertial navigation system（SINS）.It is the key part of system;and it is made up of chips with high performance and accuracy.By using DSP and FPGA technology;the circuit of navigation computer is designed.Through sequence control and program design;the problems of DSP boot-loading;communication;pulse signal counting and navigation computing are solved.According to long-time experimental test;the result shows that the computing error is less than e-10 and speed error is less than±0.5m/s.The maximum radial error is 0.490 8nm.And the navigation accuracy is 0.5nm in 24 hours.The circuit suits the demand of real-time and accuracy for navigation computing.Therefore it is important to navigation system.

title: 双位移随机脉冲位置调制技术在DC-DC变换器中的应用
abstract: 为了解决常规的脉冲宽度调制（pulse width modulation;PWM）技术由于开关的高速动作导致严重的电磁干扰问题;对双位移随机脉冲调制（dual randomized pulse position modulation;DRPPM）技术在DC-DC变换器中进行应用。该方法保持采样周期不变;在传统随机位移调制的基础上;增加1个独立的位移变量;由于2个随机变量同时作用;使得随机效果更加明显;通过Matlab仿真验证该方法的可行性和正确性;并在TMS320F28335的DSP上进行实验验证。仿真和实验结果表明:该方法可以有效减小DC-DC变换器在开关频率处的谐波峰值;使得输出电压谐波成分更加均匀地分布在较宽的频带范围内;从而减小系统的电磁干扰。

title: Application of Dual Randomized Pulse Position Modulation in DC-DC Converters
abstract: The conventional PWM（pulse width modulation） technology will cause the serious electromagnetic interference because of the high speed switching. Use DRPPM（dual randomized pulse position modulation） technology in DC-DC converter. The method can maintain the same sampling period; based on traditional randomized displacement modulation; add 1 independence displacement variable; because 2 random variables are used at the same time; the random effect is more obviously. Use Matlab simulation to verify the feasibility and correctness of method and carry out test verification in DSP of TMS320F28335. The simulation and test results show that the method can effectively reduce harmonic peak in switch frequency; make output voltage harmonic composition distribution more uniform in wider frequency band range and reduce system electromagnetic interference.
keywords: dual displacement, electromagnetic interference, harmonic, power electronics, randomized pulse position

title: 一种基于CAN总线的电机测试数据通信系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the normal testing and running of motor control system was affected by monitoring the multi-channel internal operation datum of system; a new scheme was put forward; where main controller of PWM induction motor control system TMS320F28069 and auxiliary controller TMS320F2812 were cooperated. The hardware and software of communication system of tested datum on CAN bus were designed by e CAN modules of main and auxiliary controllers. The waveforms of multi-channel variables were monitored and shown in real time with graph function of TI integrated design tools CCS3. 3. The experimental results indicate that the communication system of tested datum peculiarity such as strong anti-interference ability;good real-time;high accuracy;simpleness;reliability;no effect to main control program;and so on.

title: 低功耗网络环境下通用应用层安全协议的设计
abstract: This paper introduces a lightweight application layer security protocol called u ALS to address the security issue in the low power network environment. The implementation of u ALS is based on open SSL;and tested on BCM2836 and CC2530 which uses Contiki as its operating system. In addition;we compare u ALS with TLS / SSL by executing one experiment;and the evaluation result shows that u ALS has smaller code size;shorter time for handshaking and less resource consumption than TLS / SSL.

title: 自主潜航器姿态控制力矩陀螺群的DSP控制系统设计
abstract: To improve the low velocity control performance of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles(AUVs); asingle gimbal Control Moment Gyro(CMG)is introduced as the attitude control system; the drive system ofwhich consists of four brushless DC motors and four reducer motors. Considering the need of AUV for CMGmotors; a steady-speed control system is presented in which the brushless DC motors and worm gear reduc-er motors are based on TMS320F2812. The DSP controller module; PWM photoelectric buffer module;drive module; JTAG interface module; RS-232 SCI module and software program of the system are includ-ed. In building the peripheral circuit; only a single DSP chip is employed to control the starting or stoppingand realize the measurement of the working statement of the four brushless DC motors; and the forward orreverse response speed of the worm gear reducer motors can also be accepted. The experiment shows thatthe designed DSP control system of CMG can satisfy the attitude control requirements of AUVs.

title: Design of the autonomous underwater vehicle control moment gyro system based on DSP
abstract: To improve the low velocity control performance of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles（AUVs）; asingle gimbal Control Moment Gyro（CMG）is introduced as the attitude control system; the drive system ofwhich consists of four brushless DC motors and four reducer motors. Considering the need of AUV for CMGmotors; a steady-speed control system is presented in which the brushless DC motors and worm gear reduc-er motors are based on TMS320F2812. The DSP controller module; PWM photoelectric buffer module;drive module; JTAG interface module; RS-232 SCI module and software program of the system are includ-ed. In building the peripheral circuit; only a single DSP chip is employed to control the starting or stoppingand realize the measurement of the working statement of the four brushless DC motors; and the forward orreverse response speed of the worm gear reducer motors can also be accepted. The experiment shows thatthe designed DSP control system of CMG can satisfy the attitude control requirements of AUVs.

title: Design of Node Hardware of Urban Water Resources Monitoring system Based on WSN
abstract: The pollution of urban water resources has become one of the most serious resources and environment problems in our country;it not only affected the people’s production;daily life and health seriously;also restricted the sustainable development of our country ’s economy. Thus;an automatic;intelligent and networking urban water resource monitoring system;based on WSN;is designed to improve monitoring of urban water resources. The hardware of WSN monitoring node in city water resource monitoring nodes;employing SOC design of the integration of MCU and RF transceiver chip and using the CC2530 RF chip and CC2591 as the microprocessor and wireless communication module;is put forward in this paper. A variety of water quality parameters are collected and uploaded to the monitoring center.The experimental results show that the nodes run stably and the water quality parameters can be accurate real- time acquired.

title: Modified One-dimensional Otsu Algorithm Based on Image Complexity
abstract: Self-adaptive binaryzation is widely used in image segmentation and edge detection.Threshold extraction is one of the key technologies of digital image processing.Classic Otsu algorithm is an exhaustivity way and there will be a large computing redundancy.On condition of limited computer RAM and resource;this paper put forward a modified one-dimensional Otsu algorithm based on image complexity.According to different complexity;it improves Otsu algorithm speed on the basis of accuracy requirements.According to the experiments done on DM3730;this algorithm’s complexity is better than the classic one and its speed can be improved by about 40%.It can meet embedded system’s real-time requirements and the segmentation effect is almost the same with the classic one.

keywords: average gray value, image complexity, otsu algorithm, self-adaptive segmentation

title: 基于CPLD的DSP与CAN控制器的接口设计与实现
abstract: At present;digital signal processors(DSP) and CAN bus are applied widely to the control field. Taking the DSP TMS320F2812 and CAN controller SJA1000 as examples;the complex programmable logic device(CPLD)is used to realize the timing sequence matching effectively between data of DSP and SJA1000;and conversion of address multiplex bus and nonmultiplex bus based on the analysis of the interface timing sequence of DSP and SJA1000. It is hoped that it can provide a reference for the design of interface circuit between other microprocessors and SJA1000 CAN controller.

title: Desion on a fully wireless automatic fire alarm system based on ZigBee and GPRS
abstract: Proposed a fully wireless automatic fire alarm system integrating ZigBee and GPRS communication technologies.Sensor network adopted CC2530 chip as the main control chip and the RF chip to detect normal fire characters;for illustration;smog;flame-ray;and heat.The detection results were then analyzed by the main control chip of ZigBee-GPRS Gateway and transferred through GRPS wireless module to remote computer.Thus;the current research achieved real-time monitoring and multi-dimensional alarm of fire.

title: 光伏并网电站的远程控制系统设计
abstract: As the ambient of the photovoltaic grid-connected power station is poor; and the cost higher due to having the personnel to be on duty in a long-term; this paper proposes a design scheme of remote control system based on the Internet. Firstly; it aims to expound the tasks and functions of the remote control system; next; to select the TMS320F2812 as a controller according to the digitization requirements for the system; and to analyze the key technologies required for the remote control; including the A/D conversion; the controller’s LAN communication; FFT and the sockets; and finally; to give the design of the control software; thus realizing the monitoring of system operating status and collection of real-time parameters; which offers a reference for developing the monitoring system of the photovoltaic grid-connected power station.

title: Software Design of Telemetry Data Processing Module Based on CAN Bus
abstract: With the development of the integrated technology of aircraft electronics;data bus has been widely used in aircrafts.In order to satisfy the requirement of data bus system’s measurements for a certain aircraft;we designed a kind of telemetry data processing module based on CAN bus.The part of hardware mainly consisted with bus driving module;digital signal processing module and logic processing module.The design of software included initialization of TMS320F28335;CAN bus data processing and external interrupts.The module is used for receiving and processing of a certain aircraft’s dual CAN bus data in many flights test.The module simplified the system design;and realized the high-speed;reliable CAN bus telemetry data processing.

title: TMS320C6678的LPI雷达信号检测模型设计
abstract: According to the characteristics of LPI radar signal processing and the real-time requirement;the article designs a LPI radar signal detection processing platform based on FPGA and DSP.On a multi-core DSP processing board based on Keystone;we use parallel connection pipeline architecture and the multi-layer distribution of task scheduling to process the LPI radar signal.The design builds a whole set of model of LPI radar signal processing from the pretreatment to the output of detection result.The simulation experiment results show that the signal processing model is suitable for low SNR of LPI radar signal detection;the system resource allocation is reasonable and takes fewer logical resources.The model has great potential of real-time detection of LPI radar signal.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文围绕低截获概率雷达信号处理的特点和实时性的要求;设计了基于FPGA和DSP传统组合模式的LPI雷达信号检测处理平台。在一款基于Keystone构架的多核DSP处理板上;创新性地运用并行关联流水线体系结构和多层任务调度分配信号处理机制;构建了针对LPI雷达信号从预处理到检测结果输出的一整套信号处理模型。经过仿真实验验证;该信号处理模型适合在低信噪比条件下对LPI雷达信号进行检测;且系统资源分配合理占用逻辑资源少;具有实时检测LPI雷达信号的潜力。

title: Software Design of Telemetry Data Processing Module Based on CAN Bus
abstract: With the development of the integrated technology of aircraft electronics;data bus has been widely used in aircrafts.In order to satisfy the requirement of data bus system’s measurements for a certain aircraft;we designed a kind of telemetry data processing module based on CAN bus.The part of hardware mainly consisted with bus driving module;digital signal processing module and logic processing module.The design of software included initialization of TMS320F28335;CAN bus data processing and external interrupts.The module is used for receiving and processing of a certain aircraft’s dual CAN bus data in many flights test.The module simplified the system design;and realized the high-speed;reliable CAN bus telemetry data processing.

title: Modified One-dimensional Otsu Algorithm Based on Image Complexity
abstract: Self-adaptive binaryzation is widely used in image segmentation and edge detection.Threshold extraction is one of the key technologies of digital image processing.Classic Otsu algorithm is an exhaustivity way and there will be a large computing redundancy.On condition of limited computer RAM and resource;this paper put forward a modified one-dimensional Otsu algorithm based on image complexity.According to different complexity;it improves Otsu algorithm speed on the basis of accuracy requirements.According to the experiments done on DM3730;this algorithm’s complexity is better than the classic one and its speed can be improved by about 40%.It can meet embedded system’s real-time requirements and the segmentation effect is almost the same with the classic one.

title: Application of Hardware Semaphore on Inter-processor Communication of Multicore Processor
abstract: In the software design of multicore processor;inter-processor communication is the important part.An effective inter-processor communication mechanism can fully exploit the parallel processing ability of multicore processor.The traditional ways of inter-processor communication are interrupt and query mode;which can lead to miss interrupt and query inefficiency.In order to solve this problem;the paper presents a new inter-processor communication way based on hardware semaphore.Taking multicore DSP chip TMS320C6678 as the example;the paper introduces the operating principle;method;functional block and configuration of the hardware semaphore module;and gives an example based on two cores communication at last.

title: 基于EtherCAT总线的双馈风电机组变流器控制系统设计
abstract: Ether CAT bus was applied to realize high-speed data exchange among the modules of converter control system. The master station of Ether CAT bus was realized by AM3359;the slave station of generator control module was realized by the TMS320F28335;and the slave station of common analog and digital I / Os was realized by the STM32F107. The DSP;CPLD and high-speed &amp high-accuracy A / D converter were adopted to realize synchronous sampling for voltage and current signals and therefore complete electricity calculation. PWM signals complete the control for DC bus voltage of grid side converter and frequency &amp phase control for the voltage and current of rotor side converter by driving the IGBT through optic-fiber. With the application of Linux operation system for the master station of Ether CAT bus and the transplantation of Preempt-RT patch software the real-time performance can be provided. With the transplantation of Ether CAT master station protocols the high speed data exchange among the modules of control system can be realized. With the transplantation of CANopen higher layer protocols the data exchange between the converter and the main control system can be realized. Through the miniwatt( 110 k W) bench test;full power bench test and wind park operation it indicates that this design can ensure stable operation.

title: Hardware Design of a Small UAV Flight Control System
abstract: For the disadvantage of traditional flight control computer system with single chip; design the flight control computer system of a small UAV. Technical index and functional is formulated; and TMS320F28335 chip is used as the core controller; which integrates GPS and sensor; and expands a few of communication interfaces. All of these designs ensure the real-time and reliability of data communication; and can achieve the independent autonomous navigation of small UAV. For the characteristics of low weight; small size and small power; the flight control system can provide a reference for the design and application of small UAV.

title: 嵌入式网络控制系统设计与实现
abstract: In order to realize embedded network controller system;a embedded resolution based on Ethernet controller chip AX88180 and TMS320F2812DSP is proposed.The hardware design project;software realization method is presented.The embedded network controller system is composed of DSP;FPGA;AX88180;88E1111;network interface etc.The TMS320F2812 DSP controls communication protocol;the exchange of data between network data and parallel data is finished by FPGA chip;Ethernet controller chip AX88180 controls the network format data receiving and sending;the data exchange between the TMS320F2812 DSP and FPGA is realized by SRAM.The system is tested by 1Gbps Ethernet environment and communication frequency is 100f/s;experiments results show that the method is feasible;and the stable correct results make this method very ascendant in practical application.

title: A method of multi-signal generation with highly efficient;flexible characteristic
abstract: This paper proposes a design and implementation of multi-signal generation with highly efficient; flexible and realtime characteristic. The proposed method maks use of various technologies including digital quadrature modulation(DQM); farrow filter interpolation; signal combination to simulate multi-system and multi-mode communication signal enviroment. We implement all the designs to generate multi-signal scenes that gives frequencies between 110MHz and 170MHz in a standalone system including single FPGA and DAC5688 chips. The test results show that we can simultaneously generate 10 routine or spread spectrum signals with varaible modulation; code-rate; amplitude; frequency and phase. The DAC5688 output has a harmonic suppression up to 60dB out of instantaneous band; and suppression up to 40dB within instantaneous band.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对通信对抗复杂战场电磁环境模拟的要求;设计并实现了一种资源高效利用、样式灵活可变、参数实时可控的多通信信号产生方法。该方法经过高速缓存循环读取、通用数字正交调制、法罗滤波器内插和多通道信号合成后;产生多路不同体制、不同样式的通信信号来模拟复杂战场电磁环境。在XC6VLX240T FPGA上;对信号产生方法进行了软硬件[1]实现;通过DAC5688在140 MHz中频;60 MHz带宽内输出多路信号模拟。结果表明;该方法能够同时产生10路样式、码速率、幅度、频率均实时可变的常规、扩频、数据链或跳频通信信号;中频带外抑制优于60 dB;带内互调失真优于40 dB。
keywords: digital quadrature modulation(dqm), fpga implementation, garrow filter, multi-signal generation

title: 一种基于DSP的高速角速率陀螺数据采集模块
abstract: Aiming at the MCU can’t acquire multi high speed gyros data at the same time under conditions of multi multiply and divide method floating-point operation; design a high speed angular rate gyros data acquisition module based on DSP. The module combines with gyros data acquisition principle; introduces design method from software and hardware in detail. Based on project application; acquire and deal with certain type photoelectric tracing platform gyros data; give space disturbance angular rate measurement and angular position measurement for stabilizing and controlling circuit. The test result shows that the module can acquire 2 orthogonal high speed gyros data in real time; calculate carrier space angular position in real time; and give high precision angular rate measurement and angular position measurement for stabilizing and controlling circuit.

title: 多核DSP在无人平台探测声纳中的应用研究
abstract: Unmanned vehicles are playing a more and more important role in both military and civilian uses;thanks to the development of information technology. Target detection with unmanned underwater vehicle( UUV) is now a thriving frontier subject;in which high operational capability is the core. An underwater acoustic signal processing system based on multicore DSP is presented in this paper. Firstly we introduced some basic characteristics of multicore DSP by giving some examples on basic operations and the beamforming algorithm. Then a capacity test was taken and it was demonstrated that the system is qualified to function as a real-time signal processing system in UUV. This article shows that the design and application of this multicore DSP based system is practical in underwater acoustic signal processing.

title: A method of multi-signal generation with highly efficient;flexible characteristic
abstract: This paper proposes a design and implementation of multi-signal generation with highly efficient; flexible and realtime characteristic. The proposed method maks use of various technologies including digital quadrature modulation（DQM）; farrow filter interpolation; signal combination to simulate multi-system and multi-mode communication signal enviroment. We implement all the designs to generate multi-signal scenes that gives frequencies between 110MHz and 170MHz in a standalone system including single FPGA and DAC5688 chips. The test results show that we can simultaneously generate 10 routine or spread spectrum signals with varaible modulation; code-rate; amplitude; frequency and phase. The DAC5688 output has a harmonic suppression up to 60dB out of instantaneous band; and suppression up to 40dB within instantaneous band.

title: Optimization of optical Image Gaussian smoothing filtering based on DSP
abstract: Gaussian smoothing filtering has a good performance in averaging the noise and preserving the edge. However;the large amount of calculation limits its application in real- time image processing system. Consequently;in view of the decomposability of the Gaussian smoothing mask;an optimized Gaussian smoothing filtering method which achieves successive convolution within single traversal is proposed in this paper. Firstly;reading 4 × 8 image area is as a basic operation unit to reduce data access. Secondly;lateral convolution is parallelly computed by using the inline function;to longitudinal convolution is calculated by recomposing and reusing lateral convolution results. Finally;the image with basic operation unit is traversed;smoothing filtering results are calculated. The experimental results show that the optimized code execution time is improved more than 35 times compared to the original C code when a 320 × 240 × 8bit image is smoothed based on TMS320C6455. The proposed method has great value in engineering application.

title: Design of MIL-STD-1553B Terminal Based on FPGA
abstract: This article researched the MIL-STD-1553B bus terminal based on the FPGA and designed it in details.In the designation the DSP(TMS320F2812)was adopted as the main processor of the 1553B bus terminal;the FPGA(XC3S500E)as the 1553B protocol chip.The research carried out the circuit designations of the bus coupling、timer management、DSP、FPGA interaction and so on;and accomplished the function of the 1553B bus communication using the language of VHDL.The experiment shows that the design implement two kinds of terminal functions;and it can process a variety of message communications in multiple formats;and have great function of detect error.According to the actual project applying;the bus terminal was confirmed to have high real-timing;reliable performance and had certain application and promotion value.

title: 基于TMS320F2812的编码器电子学设计与实现
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages in the plan of dealing with the traditional encoder circuit; such as lots of discrete component; lots of adjustment potentiometer; low integration level and the loss of signal precision due to the large discreteness of the vidicon’s current value; this paper has posed an encoder design and realization based on high speed signal processor TMS320F2812 which was used as a processor core. This design has a new circuit process plan of miniaturization; intellectualization; and simplification. The design of the new plan can ensure the timeliness of the signal process and the data process time of the encoder is about 50us can deal with large numbers of data; such as the detection of signal amplitude; the inspection of signal encode channel and the wrong carry and the fast calculation of signal parameter can exchange data with PC quickly and realize the auto adjust of the precise code’s amplification parameter; amplitude parameter and the coarse code’s amplitude electrical level; which is convenient for the maintenance in the future and the periodical self maintenance to the encoder carried out by the user.

abstract: This article researched the MIL-STD-1553B bus terminal based on the FPGA and designed it in details.In the designation the DSP(TMS320F2812)was adopted as the main processor of the 1553B bus terminal;the FPGA(XC3S500E)as the 1553B protocol chip.The research carried out the circuit designations of the bus coupling、timer management、DSP、FPGA interaction and so on;and accomplished the function of the 1553B bus communication using the language of VHDL.The experiment shows that the design implement two kinds of terminal functions;and it can process a variety of message communications in multiple formats;and have great function of detect error.According to the actual project applying;the bus terminal was confirmed to have high real-timing;reliable performance and had certain application and promotion value.

title: 光学图像高斯平滑滤波的DSP优化
abstract: 高斯平滑滤波方法具有优良的噪声平滑性能和边缘保留能力;但运算量相对较大;限制了其在实时图像处理系统中的应用。本文基于高斯平滑掩膜的可分解性;提出了一种单次遍历实现两次卷积的高斯平滑滤波DSP优化方法。首先;依次打包读取4×8图像区域作为基本运算单元;有效降低对数据的重复访问;其次;在基本运算单元内;利用内联函数并行计算横向模板的一次卷积;然后;重组并复用横向模板卷积单元直接进行纵向模板的二次卷积。最后;以基本运算单元为单位遍历处理图像;计算平滑滤波结果。实验表明;利用TMS320C6455定点DSP对一幅320×240×8bit图像进行5×5高斯模板滤波耗时0.187ms;是优化前滤波耗时的1/35;具有较大的工程应用价值。

title: Design and realization of interconnect technique for high-speed data transmission between multi-processors
abstract: In order to satisfy the need of the high-speed data transmission between the multiple digital signal processors in the printed circuit board of the embedded system;this paper analyzes the common multiprocessor interconnect technology;designs the technology of the RapidIO between the multi-DSP to realize the communication within the multiprocessor in the PCB by SRIO protocols.According to the SRIO communication protocols;with the reasonable design between the two TMS320C6455 and the hardware configuration;the problem of the high-speed data transmission between the multiprocessors has been solved.Experiments show that this design of structure of the multi-DSP achieves the maximum speed of data reading and writing which arrives at the speed of 3.125Gb/s for each data transfer channel.Furthermore;this design supplies the reference mode for the interconnect technique based on the RapidIO communication protocols.

abstract: This paper examines the design of the automatic measurement system for transducer parameters;which uses floating-point digital signal processor(DSP) TMS320F28335 as the core;having the abilities of the frequency sweeping signal transmission;A/D acquisition and serial communication with the computer.The system can be set according to the display and control software;measuring parameters automatically and sending the results back to the host computer.The automatic measurement that can be achieved by the system includes the response level of transducer sending voltage;receiver sensitivity;spatial directivity and signal-to-noise ratio of the acoustic environment.In addition;the display and control functions also include automatic screenshot;generation of Word report;printing control and error warning;etc.A series of measurement process of the system can be done fully automatically.On the premise of ensuring accuracy of measurement;the system can reduce working strength of the operators;and thus improve efficiency.

abstract: In order to meet the needs of the aero-engine performance test;a design of the embedded data acquisition storage system based on SD card is introduced;the high performance DSP processor MS320LF2407A is used as the main processor.In the offline mode;it can work independently from the upper machine;the collected engine parameters is stored in Flash and SD card in double backup;also can be in online mode;through USB port directly send data to first place machine for fault diagnosis and alarm.The SD card storage performance is tested by using improved March algorithm;and the results show that the system data record is accurate; data storage is stable and reliable.

title: The design and realization of wireless monitoring system based on CC2530
abstract: Building the real-time monitoring network of staff;environment and objects of the secret place is of great significance to guarantee the security of the secret places.the traditional wired monitoring systems has lots of shortcomings such as much supplies;high cost;and power consumption.In this paper;a wireless monitoring network was set up by CC2530 chip based on zigbee wireless communication technology;and on this basis;the PC software and zigbee network software were designed;Finally;real-time monitoring of the environment and items was implemented in the classified building;including the system network test;the communication distance test and data transfer test.The test results showed that this system networked normally;data transmission was stable;the monitoring of the building worked well;and this system could be widely used in the monitoring of official places.

title: Resonant Frequency Tracking of Contractless Power Transmission System by a DSP Software Phase Locked Loop
abstract: It is known that the resonant operation of the coupled coils has important influences to reduce the reactive power and improve the transmission efficiency from the features of the resonant coupling circuit in the contractless power transmission(CPT) system.Based on above theory;a resonant frequency tracking method was presented in the CPT system by a DSP TMS320F2812 based software phase locked loop;and then the specific designing ideas and software flowcharts were introduced.Finally;the experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

title: 基于TMS320C6713的USB数据传输系统设计
abstract: USB data transfer system based on TMS320C6713 is introduced.The system adopting TMS320C6713 as the main controller and connecting TMS320C6713 with PC host by CY7C68001USB controller meets the requirements of mass data transmission by overcoming the disadvantages of traditional systems;such as limited data transfer capability and slow speed of data processing.The scheme of hardware design and the idea of software design are illustrated.The experiment result proves that the developed system has the advantages of high-speed data transmission and high reliability.
abstract_in_chinese: 介绍了基于TMS320C6713的USB数据传输系统。该系统以TMS320C6713作为主控制器;通过CY7C68001USB控制器连接TMS320C6713与PC主机;克服了传统的数据传输量小;传输速度慢的缺点;能更好地满足大容量数据的传输要求。在此详细阐明了系统的硬件设计方案和软件设计思想;并进行实现。结果证明;研制的系统具有传输速率高;可靠性好的优点。

title: 航空用永磁无刷电机复合驱动中转速波动研究
abstract: This paper analysed the sine/square wave compound driven for brushless PM motors in aircraft EMA;deduced the dynamical equation of the speed during the switch process and researched the major factors which affect the speed fluctuation.The simulation model of compound driven for brushless PM motor and the platform of the motion control system for universal motors were established.The results of the analysis;simulations and experiments prove that the speed fluctuation can be controlled within acceptable limits and the compound driven for brushless PM motor is feasibility.
abstract_in_chinese: 研究了航空EMA用永磁无刷电机正弦波/方波复合驱动策略;推导了永磁无刷电机在驱动方式切换时的转速动态方程;分析了影响切换过程中转速波动的主要因素。建立了永磁无刷电机复合驱动的仿真模型和实验平台;仿真和实验结果表明;正弦波/方波复合驱动时的转速波动可以控制在允许的范围内;验证了复合驱动控制策略的有效性。
